name: Music Pro
author: PyCmd
description: Two DJ decks with a crossfader, tempo, cue points and loops, the phone's own equaliser, bass boost, stereo widener and reverb on each deck - and a way to reach the music you keep somewhere else. It can see and drive whatever else on this phone is playing, hand a search to any music app you have installed, and search catalogues of freely licensed music you are allowed to keep. It does not stream from anybody's service and does not ask for your password to one.
